title: eludite.debug.watch input
description: Add, remove, edit or move an expression of a Watch window (Watch 1 to 4; brief 0077). Watch values are evaluated in the selected frame at every break. Give exactly one of `add`, `remove`, `edit` and `move`.

session.description: The debugging session to act on (brief 0028): its `id`, from eludite.debug.sessions or `sessions` in eludite.debug.state. Default: the active session, the one the Locals, Watch, Call Stack and Threads windows show and the execution point follows. The watch expressions are shared by every session; the answer describes this session, with the values evaluated in its selected frame. An unknown or ended id is refused with the ids of the live sessions.

remove.description: The index of the watch to remove (0 is the first row).

window.description: Which Watch window (brief 0077): 1 to 4, default 1. Watch 1's expressions persist per solution and are the state's `watches`.

edit.description: Replace an expression in place (F2 or a double click on its name).

move.description: Move a row (a drag in the window).
